header.title: OneHealth DataSpace Demos
header.lead: Open operational use cases: explore them and discover how we turn data into actionable knowledge.

item1.title: Air quality • Santiago de Compostela
item1.text: Hourly NO2 forecast, combining traffic and weather data with the GRAL dispersion model to anticipate how pollution spreads across the city.

item2.title: Portuguese man o' war • Galician beaches
item2.text: Four-day forecast of Portuguese man o' war presence along the Galician coast, connecting the marine environment with the safety of those swimming at our beaches.

item3.title: Clinical assistant
item3.text: AI-based assistant, served on CESGA's infrastructure, that answers clinical queries in Spanish as a support tool for assessment.
